name: amr_full_cycle
label: Synthetic data. Full assurance cycle: AMR 1's drive wheels wear, it is recalibrated, the twins are run jointly again, and a human approves one adjustment.
description: Fulfilment cell, full assurance lifecycle (synthetic data). AMR 1's drive wheels wear from tick 5 and settle at 12% wear: its travel speed and tote deliveries fall, Assured -> Flagged -> Nullified. Fewer totes reach the pick station, so its arrivals from AMR 1 fall below their assured range: the pick station is Flagged and the system twin with it. AMR 2's wheel-odometry speed reading drops out for two ticks (a data-quality fault, not twin error). At tick 60 the operator requests recalibration of AMR 1: the flagged-period data is split by time, both parts are sealed, only the earlier part is released to the twin's owner, and the recalibrated twin is validated on the held-out later part. The robots and pick station are then run jointly again. At tick 64 the recalibrated, semi-autonomous AMR 1 twin recommends raising its speed setpoint to bring the pick station's arrivals from AMR 1 back into their assured range; a human operator approves at tick 65; it is executed at tick 66; ticks 67-71 are checked.

objective.description: Bring the pick station's tote arrivals from AMR 1 back into their assured range
